notes.title: Version 1.0 Has Released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491671/4d152acb9f938a3681978f7c1e7003cbf39bcc4c.png[/img]

Version 1.0 has just released! This version of [b]Face Invaders[/b] is what I had in mind when I originally released the game. Please report any bugs on the Discord or Reddit. I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Major Update Coming This Friday!
notes.notes: I am planning on releasing a major update to the game Friday. I know it's very soon after launch, but I've been working on it since I finished the build I originally planned on releasing. I think it'll make the game way better.
